newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius leading stocks continue index updrive.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius leading stocks continue index updrive.

text.p: The Semdex index at the Mauritius bourse climbed by 2.22 points to 359.92 on Friday as leading shares provided further upward momentum to the index.
Volume totalled 13.37 million rupees on 566,680 shares from 19.01 million rupees on 677,625 shares on Wednesday.
The Mauritius bourse official market trades on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.
Brokers said leading shares, which bear heavy weightings on the Semdex, rose and this provided continuity to the market index upward movement.
"The first trading week of the new year saw the Semdex gaining 6.46 points. This is a further encouraging point for the market recovery which started in early December," a broker said.
But the broker added that the Semdex gain was once more soured by retreating shares of national airline Air Mauritius which shed 10 cents to 43.40 rupees on 16,160 shares.

Air Mauritius results of a 86 percent slump in its pre-tax profit for the six months ending 30 September 1996 added to concerns over the replacement of Chairman and Managing Director Sir Harry Tirvengadum -- who is leaving the company for Air Afrique in early 1997.
In the rest of the market, other leading stocks continued to climb, with shares of banking concern State Bank of Mauritius hitting another all time high.
State Bank added 20 cents to 10.70 rupees on 58,200 shares, bringing its gain to 16 percent during the past month as market analysts kept a positive assessment on the bank's performance.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 82 rupees on 36,785 shares.
Conglomerates Rogers was up 2.0 rupees to 94 on 9,996 shares and Ireland Blyth gained 30 cents to 15 rupees on 15,475 shares.
Commerce-based Courts was 20 cents higher to 5.70 rupees on 15,075 shares and Happy World Foods was unchanged at 17 rupees on 112,140 shares.
